name: Transylvania's Gambit
author: FRO_PWR
summary: Selling this gambit earns 3 random Halloween-themed gambits.
description: Adds a legendary gambit that gives up to three random Halloween-themed gambits when sold, stopping when your gambit slots are full. Its reward also runs when the gambit is destroyed during play.
